info.title: wa daemon JSON-RPC
info.description: Core method catalog of the wad daemon (line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 over the unix socket, or tunneled via POST /v1/rpc). Connections over the socket must open with system.hello. This catalog covers the stable integration surface; flag-gated and admin methods are listed in docs/manual.md section 6. Error codes: GET /v1/errors.

methods.name: system.hello
methods.summary: Protocol handshake — REQUIRED first frame on every socket connection

methods.name: status
methods.summary: Connection status (connected, paired JID)

methods.name: health
methods.summary: Extended health: staleness, last event, watchdog state

methods.name: send
methods.summary: Send a text message (allowlist + rate limits + audit apply)

schema.description: identities to @mention (phone digits or JIDs); daemon sends an ExtendedTextMessage with ContextInfo.MentionedJID and appends the matching @<number> to body when absent

methods.name: sendMedia
methods.summary: Send a media file; audio can go as a push-to-talk voice note

schema.description: daemon-local path; exactly one of path, bytes, sha256
64-hex handle of an object already in the media store
send audio as a playable voice note; requires an audio/* mime, and only Opus-in-Ogg renders a waveform (wa does not transcode)
voice-note duration hint; requires an audio/* mime

methods.name: markRead
methods.summary: Mark a chat's messages read

methods.name: sendSeen
methods.summary: Mark a chat read at its newest incoming message

methods.name: wait
methods.summary: Block until the next matching event or timeout

methods.name: search
methods.summary: Full-text history search; snippets are channel-wrapped

methods.name: thread.get
methods.summary: Newest message window of one chat (cursor-paginated, bodies channel-wrapped)

methods.name: chat.list
methods.summary: Recent chats, most recently active first

methods.name: messages.list
methods.summary: List messages with media-type/time filters

methods.name: export
methods.summary: Export one chat oldest-first as NDJSON

methods.name: contacts.search
methods.summary: FTS over the local contact mirror

methods.name: contacts.lookup
methods.summary: Resolve one JID to its contact card

methods.name: groups
methods.summary: List joined groups

methods.name: groups.get
methods.summary: Inspect one group (subject, participants)

methods.name: draft.create
methods.summary: File a human-review send proposal (the MCP draft-gate primitive)

methods.name: draft.list
methods.summary: List review-queue drafts

methods.name: draft.get
methods.summary: Fetch one draft

methods.name: draft.approve
methods.summary: Approve a pending draft — routes through the send pipeline

methods.name: draft.reject
methods.summary: Reject a pending draft

methods.name: schedule.send
methods.summary: Schedule a future send (fires through drafts for known contacts)

methods.name: schedule.list
methods.summary: List scheduled sends

methods.name: schedule.cancel
methods.summary: Cancel a pending scheduled send

methods.name: media.download
methods.summary: Lazy-fetch media for a message; transcribe=true returns a voice-note transcript

methods.name: webhook.add
methods.summary: Register a standard-webhooks endpoint (admin scope; secret returned ONCE)

methods.name: webhook.list
methods.summary: List webhook endpoints (secrets omitted)

methods.name: webhook.remove
methods.summary: Remove an endpoint and its deliveries (admin scope)

methods.name: webhook.deliveries
methods.summary: Inspect the delivery queue

methods.name: webhook.replay
methods.summary: Re-arm one delivery (dead included) for an immediate attempt

methods.name: sync.force
methods.summary: Request an on-demand history sync from the phone

methods.name: sync.status
methods.summary: In-flight sync state
